title: Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving in Road Construction Zones Using Human-in-the-Loop Driving Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.12747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ego-trajectory prediction in urban roadway work zones remains an underexplored topic in autonomous-driving research, with limited dedicated data and systematic evaluation. Roadway work zones involve temporary changes in the lane layouts and connectivity of the roads, complicating interactions with surrounding vehicles and workers. These changes make future vehicle trajectories difficult to predict. To address these challenges, we collect WZDrive-Data, a multimodal dataset comprising 1,183 work-zone driving segments from 33 drivers, using a human-in-the-loop driving simulator with prerecorded worker animations and VR-controlled workers. Driver control and gaze signals are recorded from human participants, while vehicle trajectories and scene information are obtained from the simulator. Our proposed multimodal ego-trajectory predictor, WZDrive, achieves a mean minADE (K=6) of 1.09 m and minFDE (K=6) of 2.12 m. Compared with the best-perf

translated_title: 基于人在环路驾驶数据的道路施工区域自动驾驶轨迹预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12747v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在城市道路施工区域中进行自车轨迹预测仍然是自动驾驶研究中一个未被充分探索的课题，专用数据和系统性评估都很有限。道路施工区域涉及车道布局和道路连接性的临时变化，使与周围车辆和工人的交互变得复杂，这些变化使得未来的车辆轨迹难以预测。为了应对这些挑战，我们收集了WZDrive-Data，这是一个多模态数据集，包含来自33名驾驶员的1,183个施工区域驾驶片段，使用带有预录制工人动画和VR控制工人的人在环路驾驶模拟器进行采集。驾驶员控制和注视信号从人类参与者处记录，而车辆轨迹和场景信息从模拟器中获取。我们提出的多模态自车轨迹预测器WZDrive实现了平均minADE (K=6)为1.09米和minFDE (K=6)为2.12米的性能。与表现最好的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了首个针对道路施工区域的多模态驾驶数据集WZDrive-Data，并提出了多模态自车轨迹预测器WZDrive，有效解决了施工区域车道布局临时变化导致的车辆轨迹难以预测的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WZDrive-Data, the first multimodal driving dataset for road construction zones, and proposes WZDrive, a multimodal ego-trajectory predictor that effectively addresses the challenge of predicting vehicle trajectories under temporary lane layout changes in work zones.
